full_judgment: 15. Ran an eye on contents embodied in the petition for addition of parties as well as statements in the Supplementary Affidavit and papers and documents annexed in Supplementary affidavit. Perused counter-affidavit presented by plaintiff- petitioners of Civil Revision case. From statements in petition for addition of party, it reveals that proprietors of Chameli Glass Work Ltd though Attorneys had been added as opposite parties in Miscellaneous Case No. 28 of 1995 by Court's order but they were not impleaded as respondents in the appeal and, also, not brought on record in Civil Revision as opposite parties, it further transpires that the petitioners of the petition as allottees of Government were allotted 0.75 acres of property from Industrial Plot No.190 appertaining to Cadastral Survey Plot No. 428 arid they deposited a total amount of Taka 5,66,375 + 61,83,625- 67,50,000.00 as lease money and Government executed and registered lease deed in favour of petitioners and petitioners got their names mutated in concerned Record of Right and have been paying rents to Government regularly. The petitioners, thus, appear to have interest in suit property and their presence is necessary for effective and complete adjudication of the controversy in Civil Revision case.
